subject: Qualification: deployment mode & PoC plan - Orion Tech
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Barnes <evelyn.barnes@oriontech.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap & next steps — deployment mode discussion + PoC

Hi Evelyn / Amit —

Thanks again for the call today — appreciated the time. High-level recap and suggested next steps so we can align on the PoC: 

Summary of needs (from our call)
- Primary use case: low-latency, multi-tenant inference for customer-facing chat and summarization.
- Throughput: ~15k requests/day initially with peak bursts.
- Data sensitivity: PHI in some flows (pilot with anonymization), so we need audit logs and KMS integration.
- SLOs: 95th pct latency target ~250ms for short chat queries.

Deployment options we discussed
- Hosted API: fastest to get started, lowest operational overhead, Redwood-managed.
- Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pool, predictable throughput, better isolation for performance.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): customer-controlled networking and keys, required if you need full on-prem compliance.

Questions we have to finalize PoC scope
1) Do you have a compliance requirement that mandates customer-managed KMS or on-prem only?
2) Who will be the technical owner on your side (network/security) for VPC peering if we go Private?
3) Expected PoC timeline: target 6 weeks? any hard dates?

Proposed PoC success criteria (draft)
- Implement end-to-end chat flow with Redwood (one model) in either Hosted or Dedicated.
- Demonstrate 95th pct latency <= 300ms under representative load.
- Verify audit log export and KMS integration for test data.
- Achieve functional parity vs your current baseline for accuracy on our eval set.

Attached is a short PoC plan and our security overview to help the security and infra teams.

Proposed immediate next steps
- You confirm whether Private deployment is required for compliance.
- Internal owners: please confirm the technical point of contact and procurement timeline.
- I’ll schedule a short follow-up (30 min) to lock the PoC plan once we have the answers.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a calendar invite for mid-week next week.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: 2027-02-15-redwood-poc-plan.pdf; redwood-security-overview.pdf

From: Evelyn Barnes <evelyn.barnes@oriontech.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Amit Singh <amit.singh@oriontech.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 09:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps — deployment mode discussion + PoC

Thanks, Jordan — great recap. A few quick answers and clarifications from our side: 

1) Compliance: For the pilot we can use Hosted or Dedicated as long as audit logs and KMS are available. Full Private/VPC would be required for production for certain customers, but not necessary for the initial PoC.
2) Technical owners: Amit will be the technical lead from infra, and I’ll loop in our security manager (TBD) for the KMS questions — he’s out this week but can join the kickoff.
3) Timeline: 6 weeks is fine as a target. We have a leadership review on 2027-03-31, so if we can show initial results by 3/15 that would be ideal.

We reviewed the security overview and it looks reasonable — our security team will likely want a few clarifications around key rotation and retention windows.

Next: please send the finalized PoC plan and a calendar invite. Also can you include an estimate for Dedicated capacity cost vs Hosted for our expected load? That will help procurement.

—Evelyn
Evelyn Barnes
Head of Product | Orion Tech
evelyn.barnes@oriontech.com | +1 617-555-0144

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Barnes <evelyn.barnes@oriontech.com>, Amit Singh <amit.singh@oriontech.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 11:20:00 -08:00
Subject: PoC plan + cost estimates (draft)

Evelyn / Amit —

Thanks for the quick replies. I’ve attached the formal PoC plan (short timeline + owners) and a preliminary cost comparison: Hosted vs Dedicated (monthly estimate based on your projected throughput). High level: Hosted gets you up fastest; Dedicated is roughly 35% cheaper at scale and gives stronger isolation/throughput guarantees.

Key updates in the attached PoC plan:
- Duration: 6 weeks (kickoff, model validation, load test, evaluation)
- Success criteria: latency, accuracy, KMS/audit verification, integration checklist completed
- Stakeholders: Evelyn (product), Amit (infra), your security manager (TBD), Jordan (sales), Ben (solutions), Marissa (implementation lead)
- Deliverables: test harness, traffic replay, load test report, security evidence export

Ben / Marissa can you confirm the technical prerequisites and the simplest way to run the PoC for Orion (Hosted pilot vs Dedicated trial)? I put both options in the plan but want your recommendation.

I’ll schedule a 30-min kickoff for Wednesday; calendar invite to follow.

Jordan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Barnes <evelyn.barnes@oriontech.com>, Amit Singh <amit.singh@oriontech.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PoC plan + cost estimates (draft) — technical notes

Thanks — quick technical notes and recommendation from Solutions: 

Recommendation: Start the PoC on Hosted API with the option to flip to Dedicated mid-PoC if you hit throughput/latency limits. That minimizes setup friction (no VPC/networking initially) and still lets us validate latency and KMS/export features.

Technical checklist for Hosted pilot:
- Provision API keys scoped to PoC project (we’ll generate).
- Provide a sample traffic replay (JSON lines) and an eval set (CSV).
- Confirm whether PHI will be masked for the initial test data; if not, we’ll need the KMS requirements sooner.
- Endpoint configuration: 8k token/session upper bound, stream responses enabled for chat.
- Access for Marissa (implementation) and Ben to your staging environment for integration tests (SSH/VPN? — if Hosted we just need API access).

If you prefer Dedicated from day 1: we’ll need a procurement window for reserved capacity (2–4 weeks to provision) and AWS account/network details for routing.

I’ll join the kickoff and can run a quick smoke test within 48 hours of keys being available.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Evelyn Barnes <evelyn.barnes@oriontech.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Amit Singh <amit.singh@oriontech.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 11:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: PoC plan + cost estimates (draft)

Jordan / Ben / Marissa —

This all looks good and aligned with our expectations. We’ll proceed with a Hosted pilot first, with a decision point at week 3 to evaluate Dedicated if needed.

Action items on our side:
- Amit will share a sanitized traffic replay and eval set by Monday 2027-02-22.
- I’ll confirm our security manager for the KMS review (expected by 2027-02-25).
- Procurement: I’ll ask procurement for a preliminary cost approval for Dedicated in case we need to pivot mid-PoC.

Please send the kickoff invite and we’ll accept. Looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Evelyn
Head of Product | Orion Tech
